name: pathprune
description: Ignore-aware dead-file and duplicate-path scout with safe cleanup previews.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node bin/pathprune.js check fixtures/duplicate-docs --format text --max-findings 10 && node bin/pathprune.js check fixtures/duplicate-docs --format json --max-findings 10 >/tmp/pathprune-smoke.json
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run check && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run package:smoke

author: Roger Chappel
